subject: POC lab access & hybrid session — calendar sync
messages:
From: Alex Li <alex.li@finco.com>

Cc: sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 13 Dec 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: POC kickoff — onsite ask and AV/visitor details

Hi Ben / Marissa,

Thanks again for the time earlier. We want to confirm logistics for the POC hands-on session. Our initial preference is onsite at FinCo HQ (San Francisco) on Monday Dec 20, 10:00–14:00. Key asks from our side:

- AV (projector + dual-screen) and a system HDMI/USB-C check before guests arrive.
- Visitor badges and escort rules — security needs 24h advance names.
- Can you run a short load test (prompt routing and steady token throughput) to validate latency during peak step?
- We are sensitive about recordings: need to confirm where recordings will be stored and retention policy.

We can be flexible to hybrid if Redwood prefers — but would like clarity on recording and on-call engineer who can help with load routing during the session.

Attaching the internal agenda draft.

Cheers,
Alex

Attachment: finco_internal_kick_agenda.pdf (attachment stub)
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Li <alex.li@finco.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — onsite ask and AV/visitor details

Alex — thanks, this is helpful. A few quick notes and a proposed change: 

- We can support onsite AV, but to reduce friction we'd prefer a hybrid-first run: Redwood staff join remotely for the first hour for the prompt walkthrough, then move to hands-on pods either onsite or virtual rooms. This avoids travel delays and ensures our on-call engineer is immediately available.
- Sergio will be the on-call engineer for load/routing. He'll own the 11:30–12:00 load test window and watch prefix/KV caching behavior.
- Marissa will run the prompt review and sample routing table updates.
- Regarding recordings: Redwood can host the recording on our secure S3 with a 90‑day retention by default. If FinCo requires shorter retention or hashed storage, we can adjust — need procurement confirmation.

Proposed schedule (alternative): Tue Dec 21, 09:30–12:30 PT — gives security team time to process visitor passes and lets us run a dry-run Monday morning. If that works, I'll send a calendar invite and a short prep checklist.

Attaching: poc_agenda_v2.pdf (agenda + session runbook).

Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Li <alex.li@finco.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rachel Chen <rachel.chen@finco.com>, procurement@finco.com, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — onsite ask and AV/visitor details

Ben — thanks for the fast follow. We are fine moving to Tue Dec 21 09:30–12:30. A few follow-ups from security/procurement: 

- Recording: FinCo policy requires recordings be stored on our tenant (Google Drive) and purged after 45 days. Is Redwood able to upload the recording to a shared Drive link instead of S3?
- Visitor passes: Can you send a completed visitor_pass_form for each Redwood attendee by 2026-12-20 09:00?
- Screen sharing: IT prefers participants use the company Zoom; do you have a Zoom link we can add to the invite?

Also — for the load test: can you provide a short list of prompts and expected token rates so our infra team can simulate realistic traffic? If you attach the prompt_playbook that would help.

Thanks,
Alex
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Li <alex.li@finco.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, procurement@finco.com
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — onsite ask and AV/visitor details

Alex — confirmed for Tue Dec 21 09:30–12:30. Notes/actions below so everything is in one place: 

1) Recording storage: We can record on our Zoom and upload the MP4 to the FinCo Drive folder (shared link) immediately after the session; we'll mark the file with a 45-day deletion tag and request FinCo to confirm purge once complete. If procurement/Rachel need a formal SLA, I can loop Legal.

2) Visitor passes: Attached visitor_pass_form.pdf — please forward the completed forms back to us. Our onsite attendees: Ben Carter, Marissa Cole, Sergio Alvarez (all will bring photo ID).

3) Screen sharing / Zoom: We'll use the Redwood Zoom room for consistency; Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210 — happy to switch to FinCo's room if required, but using our link makes it simpler to record and to add co-hosts. If FinCo IT requires, we can add Rachel as a co-host and hand off recording ownership to FinCo after upload.

4) Load test / prompts: Attached prompt_playbook.docx with ~8 sample prompts and expected token volumes and concurrency (peak ~18 reqs/s sustained for 5 mins; burst to 40 reqs/s for 30s). Sergio will coordinate a 11:30–11:40 ramp and hold 11:40–11:45 steady.

5) Dry-run: Redwood prefers a short remote dry-run Monday Dec 20 at 09:00 PT to validate AV, screen-share, and the Zoom→Drive recording handoff. Will you confirm access for our test?

I'll send the updated calendar invitation with agenda/links after you confirm pass timing.

Ben

Attachments: visitor_pass_form.pdf, prompt_playbook.docx
